name: PlanningAutomationCard
srcText:
/** Settings → Planner: RETIRED, and kept only because the store cannot yet be written.
 *
 *  This card offered three toggles — "Automate planning with the LLM", "Auto-advance planner gates"
 *  and "Allow gate override" — that wrote `autoPlanWithClaude`, `autoCompleteGates` and
 *  `allowGateOverride`. NOTHING READ ANY OF THEM: the setters did not even write through, and the two
 *  engines the prose described (`decideAutopilotAction`, `shouldAutoCompleteGate`) have no callers.
 *  The prose promised an "Auto-plan" control and an "override gate & continue" button that no record
 *  renders. The three fields are gone as of
 *  `settings-remove-the-dead-controls-and-the-false-prose`, so this component can no longer be built.
 *
 *  IT IS NO LONGER MOUNTED — `PlannerPage` does not import it, so it is unreachable from the UI.
 *  The record itself survives because `bsc ui set` was removed by the ui→components rename and
 *  `bsc components` has no write verb, so nothing can delete it from the component store
 *  (`the-ui-rename-dropped-the-component-library-read`). Deleting the SEED FILE alone breaks
 *  `platformBoundary` ("in the manifest but not registered") and `seed_for_seed`, because the
 *  manifest is itself a store record the file cannot be reconciled with. Delete the record, the seed
 *  and its manifest entry together once that regression lands. */
export function PlanningAutomationCard() {
  return null;
}
